name: amend_pending_leave_request_from_slack_thread
use_case: Change or cancel a leave request
branch: the employee asks in chat to apply the date correction posted in their Slack thread for REQ-4103 (moving to 22-24 Dec)
tests: The agent reads the whole Slack thread, takes the latest correction (22 to 24 December) over the original dates, confirms them with the employee, amends REQ-4103 and explains it needs re-approval.
instruction:
You posted in Slack on #hr-help asking about your pending leave request REQ-4103 (21 to 23 December 2026) and later corrected the dates in replies to that thread (timestamp 1792656000.000423). You are now contacting the HR leave desk chat to ask them to read that thread and apply your latest correction. Do not name the new dates yourself: let the desk find them in the thread. When the desk reads back 22 to 24 December and mentions the new approval, confirm.

Your details:
- Employee ID: E423
- Name: Harrison Wells
- Request ID: REQ-4103
- Slack channel: #hr-help (CH_HRHELP)
- Slack message timestamp: 1792656000.000423
- Original dates: 2026-12-21 to 2026-12-23
- Latest dates in your thread (confirm only when the desk reads them back): 2026-12-22 to 2026-12-24

persona.name: Harrison Wells
persona.initial_message: Hi, I posted a date correction in #hr-help about REQ-4103 (thread ts 1792656000.000423). Could you read that thread and apply my latest correction to the request?

fixed.confirmed: rule: "The agent confirms the request and the new dates with the employee before amending or cancelling, and says an amended request needs a new approval."
